deals.date_text: 2018/19 season (restructuring plan approved by Enschede council on 8 April 2019)
deals.evidence: voor € 8,9 mio aan nieuw kapitaal ingebracht
deals.headline: Regional backers put EUR 8.9m of new equity into FC Twente
deals.investor: Noabers FC Twente B.V. and Ambassadeurs FC Twente B.V. (regional businesses)
deals.summary: A share programme backed by Twente businesses brought in EUR 8.9m of new capital; Noabers FC Twente B.V. (21.71% of votes) and Ambassadeurs FC Twente B.V. (2.43%) joined Stichting FC Twente '65 (75.86%) as shareholders.

deals.evidence: herstructurering met € 17 mio teruggebracht tot € 19,3 mio
deals.headline: Restructuring with the municipality and creditors cuts FC Twente's debts by EUR 17m
deals.summary: Enschede's council approved the club's restructuring plan on 8 April 2019, backed by the municipality, Noabers, Ambassadeurs and creditors; debts were reduced by EUR 17m to EUR 19.3m.

deals.evidence: nieuwe voorwaarden overeengekomen voor de nog niet afgeloste hoofdsom van €17.323.568
deals.headline: FC Twente refinances EUR 17.3m of its 2007 EUR 20m loan at 3.25% to 2042
deals.summary: New terms on the outstanding principal of the 2007 4.75% EUR 20m loan: fixed 3.25% to 1 March 2042, secured by a first mortgage on the Colosseum 65 property and assignment of business-seat income; EUR 4.409m outstanding at 30 June 2025.

deals.evidence: Dit betreft een lening van €8.400.000 die oorspronkelijk op 1 maart 2017 is opgenomen
deals.headline: FC Twente Stadion B.V. takes a EUR 8.4m municipally guaranteed loan
deals.investor: Credit institution (not named), guaranteed by Gemeente Enschede
deals.summary: A EUR 8.4m loan drawn by group company FC Twente Stadion B.V., re-termed on 3 December 2018 at 1.835% to 1 March 2047; the municipality of Enschede guarantees it against a EUR 2.4m risk premium and pledges on TV, stadium-naming and sponsor income.

deals.evidence: De achtergestelde schuld aan de Gemeente Enschede is per 30 juni 2024 omgezet naar een niet rentedragende
deals.headline: Enschede converts its subordinated loan to FC Twente into interest-free 15-year debt
deals.summary: The municipality's subordinated debt was converted into a non-interest-bearing long-term debt repaid in equal instalments over 15 years; EUR 4.824m outstanding at 30 June 2025.

founded_evidence: FC Twente wordt in 1965 opgericht, uit een fusie tussen Enschedese Boys en Sportclub Enschede
name: FC Twente '65 B.V.
notes: FC Twente's 2025/26 accounts were not yet on fctwente.nl on 3 Oct 2026 (2024/25's were adopted 7 Oct 2025), so figures are 2024/25: revenue EUR 61.7m (accounts: 61,690k), net profit EUR 14.779m, equity EUR 42.3m, pre-tax EUR 19.928m. Operating result is the club's 'operationeel bedrijfsresultaat' before transfer activities (accounts: bedrijfsresultaat 9,553k); transfer result EUR 10.5m. Shareholdings are as stated in the 2018/19 accounts after the share programme; by 30 June 2025 the share register showed 5,761 A, 20,000 B and 649 C shares (2019: 5,725 / 20,000 / 642), so current percentages differ slightly and no page states them. The 2024/25 accounts say only that the foundation holds a majority of shares and votes. Noabers/Ambassadeurs are vehicles of regional business backers, not institutional funds. Stadium owner not stated on a page I could read: the group company FC Twente Stadion B.V. carries the stadium loan and the group books EUR 40.7m of buildings and land, but ownership of De Grolsch Veste is not spelled out. Evidence for table figures (wages, pre-tax) is the row as a text-layout PDF reader renders it. D-reizen is back-of-shirt partner from 1 July 2026; GGM Gastro main (front) sponsor from 1 July 2025 for two seasons. Erik ten Hag is technical director (statutory board). Occupancy over 98% in 2024/25 but no average attendance figure. No valuation or social counts found.

ownership_summary: FC Twente '65 B.V. is controlled by Stichting FC Twente '65, a foundation with a majority of the shares and votes whose board includes two members nominated by the supporters' association Twente, verenigt!. Since the 2019 restructuring two vehicles of regional business backers, Noabers FC Twente B.V. and Ambassadeurs FC Twente B.V., also hold shares (21.71% and 2.43% of the votes in 2019, the foundation 75.86%).
revenue_evidence: De omzet over seizoen 2024-2025 is ten opzichte van vorig seizoen met circa €20,3 miljoen gestegen naar €61,7 miljoen.
stadium_capacity_evidence: In 2011 werd het stadion uitgebreid tot een capaciteit van 30.000 toeschouwers
